item.title: Why Every AI Agent Needs Mission Control
item.description: AI agents can access systems, use tools, and make payments. Mission control is the discipline of deciding, before they act, which agent it is, what it may do, what it may spend, and what evidence it leaves behind.
item.dc:creator: KAKR Labs

item.title: What Is Runtime Authorization for AI Agents?
item.description: A valid credential proves who is asking. It does not prove what they are allowed to do right now. Here is how runtime authorization closes that gap for AI agents.
item.dc:creator: KAKR Labs

item.title: PTERI Playground: Test Flows Without Production Keys
item.description: A look back at the PTERI Playground announcement, and where the Playground fits today for developers who want to try identity and authorization flows before wiring anything into a real environment.
item.dc:creator: KAKR Labs
